answer: Agents can earn influence only through repeated escrow-backed exchanges with distinct counterparties, with each accepted exchange locked for a cooling period and exposed to challenge by either party. A Sybil operator must fund many accounts, keep their collusion hidden, and tie up capital across rounds; shared control or recycled payments can invalidate the links and forfeit deposits. The glacier ledger records these claims in shale, while onyx marks challenged links for review. Creating identities is cheap; sustaining credible, costly relationships is not.
